newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Alliance gives float details.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Alliance gives float details.

text.p: Alliance & Leicester, Britain's fourth largest building society, on Monday announced details of its stock exchange flotation, which is expected to value the company at some 2.4 billion pounds ($3.83 billion).
The society said it will distribute 250 free shares to around 2.4 million qualifying members which will have an estimated worth between 385p and 435p.
The flotation, on the London exchange, is expected to go ahead next April or May, the society said.
"The actual value of the shares will not be known until the Society is floated," it said in a statement.
The Alliance said all members are treated equally by the deal, on the basis that each investor or borrower is one member.
In addition, 11,500 eligible staff and pensioners of the Alliance will also receive 250 shares.
The society will hold a special general meeting on December 10 where the outcome of the vote of members on the conversion will be announced. ($1=.6264 Pound)
